share.broken: Could not read the shared design: {{message}}

welcome.title: Welcome to InteriorAI
welcome.body: A one-minute tour: draw the layout → place furniture → view in 3D → render and quote.

tools.title: 1. Draw the layout
tools.body: Pick the Wall or Room tool and click on the canvas to draw your first wall; doors and windows snap onto walls. Number keys switch tools.

assets.title: 2. Place furniture
assets.body: Drag furniture from the library into 2D or 3D — it snaps to nearby walls. Drag materials from the Materials tab onto walls and floors.

view.title: 3. Switch 2D / 3D
view.body: Switch to 3D any time to walk through (WASD), change day/night lighting and save camera bookmarks.

inspector.title: 4. Edit properties
inspector.body: Select any wall, opening, furniture or light to edit its size, material, brightness, color temperature and angle here.

ai.title: 5. Let AI help
ai.body: “AI auto-furnish” generates three styled layouts in one click; the “AI design assistant” edits the scene by chat — you confirm every change.

output.title: 6. Quote, gallery and share
output.body: Get a BOM and quote automatically (export to Excel / PDF), keep screenshots and 720° panoramas in the gallery, and share a link with your client.
